summary: Setup's companion step no longer writes a docs-folder graphify ignore file. The file only limited the docs graph to Markdown files, a small gain, and graphify already skips the paths setup keeps out of Git (the managed .gitignore block lists the local runtime folder), so the extra file duplicated a rule the project already had and appeared as an untracked or tracked change after every companions apply. A project that already has the file keeps it.
